name: Visaman Global Sales Ltd.
summary: Visaman Global Sales Ltd. operates as a business-to-business (B2B) supplier specializing in the trading and distribution of industrial products within the steel and metal industry. The company's primary offerings include a diverse range of steel and metal components such as structural steel, TMT bars, HR/CR coils, BGL coils, GP(GI) coils, MS sheets, GP and GC sheets, CR sheets, HR sheets and plates, color-coated sheets, roofing PUF panels, wall PUF panels, and various types of pipes including round, square, and rectangle pipes. Visaman Global Sales Ltd. functions as an intermediary in the supply chain, procuring products from manufacturers and distributors, and managing logistics and warehousing to ensure the timely delivery of bulk metal orders. The company serves industrial clients across different sectors, primarily focusing on the construction, infrastructure, and manufacturing industries in Gujarat and the surrounding regions of India. Additionally, it provides value-added services such as credit facilities to its existing customers, product customization to meet specific client requirements, and comprehensive third-party logistics services, including onsite product delivery. Its business model emphasizes procurement, inventory management, and distribution, underpinned by credit management and maintaining a reliable supply chain for a wide array of steel specifications.
